notes.rules: Under Egypt's Labour Law (Law 14 of 2025, Art. 156) an open-ended contract can be ended with written notice of at least three months, and Art. 161 says the notice period cannot be waived or reduced.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. This applies to open-ended contracts; fixed-term contracts and probation follow different rules, and ending a contract without a legitimate reason can carry compensation. Confirm with your employer or the Ministry of Labour.
